title: Gita Chapter 12: Bhakti Yoga
author: Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 12
intro: The shortest chapter of the Gita and the heart of devotion. Arjuna asks which devotee is best; Krishna answers, then describes the qualities of a devotee who is dear to him: friendly, compassionate, the same in praise and blame.
note: More chapters of the Gita will be added. The text follows the commonly printed (Gita Press) reading.
